name: gc-violations
command: sh -c 'r="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -n "$r" ] && grep -q "^# Process binding" "$r/docs/PROCESS.md" 2>/dev/null; then mkdir -p "$r/.ground-control" && touch "$r/.ground-control/violations.log" && exec tail -F "$r/.ground-control/violations.log"; else exec tail -f /dev/null; fi'
description: ground-control guard violations surfaced live (experimental component; Claude Code v2.1.105+)
